Hungary's longtime strongman Viktor Orbán spent 16 years building one of the world’s most prominent illiberal democracies.

Now, the country’s new prime minister, Péter Magyar, is trying to tear that old system down.

Can he do this while sticking to democratic norms?

My thoughts:
